title: NLP for Maternal Healthcare: Perspectives and Guiding Principles in the Age of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Participatory design approach involving interactive LLM chatbot demonstrations, followed by quantitative surveys of ethical value prioritization (e.g., fairness, inclusiveness) and qualitative thematic analysis of stakeholder discussions regarding maternal health disparities.
